args.Description: "Simplify clinic tour scroll handling by removing IntersectionObserver and always handling wheel/touch within the section view."
args.Instruction: "Replace the existing useEffect block for clinic tour scroll logic with a streamlined version that checks section visibility on each wheel/touch event and updates slide index accordingly. Remove IntersectionObserver, isLocked, and related lock/unlock functions. Use a flag isTransitioning to debounce transitions. Ensure the event listeners are attached to the window with passive:false for wheel and touchmove. Add cleanup to remove listeners."
